name: Cardioid Julia Breath
promptTemplate: A low-res demoscene Julia set breathing along the Mandelbrot cardioid with {{palette}} tones, running at {{tempo}} speed, with {{fractal_zoom}} zoom and {{iterations}} iterations under {{audio_reactivity}} music response.

palette.hint: Direct color ramp for the 512-entry LUT

fractal_zoom.hint: Scale viewport into the breathing border

iterations.hint: Calculation depth: sharp dendrites or soft dust

audio_reactivity.hint: Bass-kick pulse displacement on the boundary

listing.blurb: A Julia set whose constant travels slowly around the edge of the Mandelbrot cardioid, so the fractal breathes between dust, dendrites and spirals, rendered on a low-resolution buffer with smooth colouring.
listing.prompt: A Julia set whose constant travels slowly around the edge of the Mandelbrot cardioid, so the fractal breathes between dust, dendrites and spirals, rendered on a low-resolution buffer with smooth colouring. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
